name: CommentSold
description_en:
CommentSold is a video-first retail commerce system combining live selling, shoppable clips, a branded mobile app, storefront, inventory and fulfilment. Comments, auctions and scheduled broadcasts connect audience interaction to a cart or invoice rather than only distributing video.

CommentSold, Videeo for Shopify and pop.store are separate named offers. This profile concerns the CommentSold retail platform; a Shopify plugin or creator product should not be assumed to have the same catalogue, price or operational workflow.
description_zh:
CommentSold 是视频优先零售系统，结合直播销售、可购买短视频、品牌移动应用、店面、库存及履约。评论、拍卖和预约直播把观众互动连接购物车或账单，而不仅是传播视频。

CommentSold、Videeo for Shopify 和 pop.store 是分别命名的方案。本文介绍 CommentSold 零售平台，不能假定 Shopify 插件或创作者产品拥有相同目录、价格或运营流程。

core_features.explanation_en: Choose live, auction or scheduled prerecorded formats with product-linked selling.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择直播、拍卖或预约预录形式，并关联商品销售。

core_features.explanation_en: The platform connects live sales with inventory and automated invoicing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 平台将直播销售连接库存及自动账单。

core_features.explanation_en: Plans combine a monthly base with a percentage of sales.
core_features.explanation_zh: 套餐结合每月基础费和销售额百分比。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_zh: 准备一场从直播到履约的销售
sections.en: The live page describes selecting a broadcast format, choosing products and going live, with invoicing and inventory updates. A boutique could demonstrate a few variants, then inspect the cart, paid order and stock before packing. Test an out-of-stock size, unpaid cart and cancelled order; the page does not establish the exact reservation or release timing. No broadcast or sale was performed.
sections.zh: 直播页描述选择播放形式、商品及开播，并连接账单和库存更新。精品店可展示少量规格，再核对购物车、已付订单及库存后打包。应测试缺货尺码、未付款购物车和取消订单；页面未说明具体预留及释放时点。本文未开播或成交。

sections.title_en: Automatic auction charging needs explicit setup
sections.title_zh: 拍卖自动扣费需要明确配置
sections.en: The vendor says auction winners can be charged through their saved payment method, while ordinary live orders use automated invoicing. Those are different payment paths. Configure bidder payment eligibility and fulfilment rules, and ask how failed charges or disputed bids are handled. A scheduled prerecorded show still needs live comment moderation and inventory preparation; recording a video alone does not operate the sale.
sections.zh: 厂商说明拍卖获胜者可通过已保存付款方式自动扣费，普通直播订单则使用自动账单，两者支付路径不同。应配置竞拍支付资格和履约规则，并询问扣费失败或竞价争议如何处理。预约预录节目仍需准备评论管理及库存，仅录好视频不等于已经运营销售。

sections.title_en: Estimate both the fixed fee and sales percentage
sections.title_zh: 同时估算固定费与销售比例
sections.en: The retrieved pricing lists Starter at US$149/month plus 6% of sales, Starter with AI at US$249 plus 6%, Small Business at US$499 plus 5%, and Large Business at US$999 plus 4%. AI credits and API/support scope differ by tier. These percentages are part of platform pricing, not a verified replacement for payment processing. Confirm the definition of sales, returns, tax, shipping and any additional payment costs before estimating a bill.
sections.zh: 读取定价列出 Starter 每月 149 美元加销售额 6%，Starter with AI 为 249 美元加 6%，Small Business 为 499 美元加 5%，Large Business 为 999 美元加 4%。AI credits、API 及支持范围按层级不同。这些比例属于平台定价，未核实能否取代支付处理费。估算账单前需确认销售额、退货、税费、运费及其他支付费用定义。

sections.title_en: Choose for a maintained live-selling operation
sections.title_zh: 适合持续运营直播销售
sections.en: Retailers producing regular product demonstrations have a relevant reason to evaluate it. A software subscription business or a store without video operations may need a different model. Prepare product variants, payment account, fulfilment process and permitted social accounts; each social platform has its own eligibility requirements. The Starter trial is advertised for 15 days, not permanent free use. No self-hosted package, licence agreement, sales uplift or recovery guarantee was verified.
sections.zh: 持续制作商品展示的零售商有具体评估理由。软件订阅业务或不运营视频的店铺可能需要其他模式。应准备商品规格、支付账户、履约流程及有权使用的社交账户；各社交平台有独立准入条件。Starter 广告提供 15 天试用，并非永久免费。本文未核实自托管包、许可合同、销售提升或恢复保证。
